text:
marta_marketing: Heads-up: Summit launch next Wed. Need a compact bench pack for the web post + demo. Primary ask: long-context streaming latencies (up to 8k tokens) and embedding encode time for rerank demo. Can runtime run a quick smoke today?

olivia_data: Please include per-request streaming-first-byte, per-token-generation ms, P50/P90/P99, error rates, memory snapshots, and a small sample set (50 requests) with seeds. Also want embedding qps and 95/99 quantiles. Filenames should include model tag + warmup.

rory_runtime: We can run this on cluster-staging. Need exact model + export tag, sequence distribution, traffic profile, and whether you want int4 in the comparison set. Also confirm anonymized traces allowed.

marta_marketing: Model: redwood-summit-7b-instruct export v1. Compare: fp16, int8, int4. Seq mix: 70% 1024, 20% 4096, 10% 8192. Traffic: nominal 5 qps, spike to 50 qps for 30s every 10m. Warmup: 500. Use seed=1337 for generation determinism. Anonymized traces fine.

alex_eng: Note: int4 currently only on nodepool-compact. If you want a fair comparison we should run each variant on its preferred pool to avoid throttling artifacts. Also we should reserve 45m.

ci-bot: job_5102 scheduled on cluster-staging (nodepool-compact for int4) start 1767779000 end 1767779800

rory_runtime: Starting fp16 run now. Warmup 500 -> measurement 2k requests sampled per profile. Will capture streaming-first-byte by measuring time to first chunk and per-token ms from server-side counters. Uploading to s3 on completion.

rory_runtime: fp16 run done. Summary (streaming-first-byte): P50=90ms, P90=200ms, P99=480ms. Per-token gen: P50=12ms/token, P90=18ms/token, P99=30ms/token. Error rate 0.2% (transient 429s during a short spike). Embedding encode P50=9ms, P90=25ms. Coldstart-first-byte 1.1s. Artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/marketing/summit/1767778888/fp16_warmup500_seed1337/

rory_runtime: int8 run in progress on nodepool-standard now.

rory_runtime: int8 run complete. Summary: streaming-first-byte P50=95ms, P90=220ms, P99=520ms. Per-token P50=13ms, P90=20ms, P99=35ms. Error rate 0.3%. int8 artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/marketing/summit/1767778888/int8_warmup500_seed1337/

rory_runtime: int4 run complete (nodepool-compact). Summary: first-byte P50=130ms, P90=300ms, P99=820ms. Per-token P50=16ms, P90=28ms, P99=60ms. Error rate 1.1% (OOM backoffs observed ~minute 12 of the run). Uploaded artifacts and memory flame snapshots: s3://redwood-inference/marketing/summit/1767778888/int4_warmup500_seed1337/

olivia_data: Quick scan 1: int4 tail looks unstable. Can we re-run int4 with increased warmup (2k) and a slightly lower burst profile (spikes to 30 qps) to see if OOM/backoff is warmup-related vs capacity? Also include a raw CSV with per-request fields: timestamp, seq_len, first_byte_ms, total_ms, tokens, error_code, cost_estimate_usd.

rory_runtime: Good catch. Scheduling int4 extended warmup run at 1767779400. Will do warmup 2000, measurement 2k, and reduced spikes. Will diff memory flamegraphs and upload a short note.

ci-bot: job_5108 scheduled start 1767779400 end 1767779800 on nodepool-compact

rory_runtime: Extended int4 run finished. Tail improved: P99 dropped from 820ms -> 540ms, error rate 0.4%. OOMs no longer reproduced. Artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/marketing/summit/1767778888/int4_warmup2000_seed1337/ README included and a `replay.sh` with reproduction steps. One-line reproduce: `./replay.sh --s3-prefix s3://redwood-inference/marketing/summit/1767778888/ --seed 1337 --warmup 2000`

marta_marketing: Incredible 1 Thanks team. Olivia 1 we should highlight the int4 caveat and note the warmup sensitivity in the blog. Also call out streaming-first-byte numbers for demo.

olivia_data: Agreed. I'll pull the CSVs and draft a short appendix with methodology and the one-line repro command. If we need tighter percentile probing (P99.9) or end-to-end demo isolation, flag here and we can request dedicated pool for the live demo.

alex_eng: If you want a dedicated pool for the webinar, ping with dates and we'll spin one up (30m prep).

marta_marketing: Will do. Closing for now  thanks everyone!
